name: Libice nad Doubravou (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a white band into a green upper hoist part and a blue lower fly part.
history: Czech municipal flags are granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
